```yaml
name: Build Daytona Snapshot

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      commit_sha:
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: "The name of the built Daytona snapshot"
        value: ${{ jobs.build_snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build_snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.set_output.outputs.snapshot_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate Commit SHA
        env:
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$COMMIT_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Error: Invalid commit SHA format. Expected 40-character hex string."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set Snapshot Name
        id: set_snapshot_name
        env:
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          SNAPSHOT_NAME="iterate-sandbox-${COMMIT_SHA}"
          echo "snapshot_name=$SNAPSHOT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Using snapshot name: $SNAPSHOT_NAME"

      - name: Build and Push Snapshot
        env:
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          SNAPSHOT_NAME="iterate-sandbox-${COMMIT_SHA}"
          
          # Check if snapshot already exists to handle idempotency
          # Note: This assumes a Daytona CLI or API client is available and configured
          # If using a custom script, ensure it handles the 'already exists' case gracefully
          if command -v daytona &> /dev/null; then
            if daytona snapshot list | grep -q "$SNAPSHOT_NAME"; then
              echo "Snapshot $SNAPSHOT_NAME already exists. Skipping build."
            else
              echo "Building snapshot $SNAPSHOT_NAME..."
              # Assuming a build script exists in the repo that handles the actual Daytona snapshot creation
              # This script should enforce SANDBOX_ITERATE_REPO_REF and handle the naming
              npm run build:snapshot -- --name "$SNAPSHOT_NAME" --ref "$COMMIT_SHA"
            fi
          else
            echo "Daytona CLI not found. Assuming snapshot build is handled by external process or script."
            # Fallback or placeholder if specific CLI isn't available in this context
            # In a real scenario, you might call a specific script like ./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh
            if [ -f "./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh" ]; then
              ./scripts/build-daytona-snapshot.sh "$SNAPSHOT_NAME" "$COMMIT_SHA"
            else
              echo "No build script found. Please ensure the snapshot build mechanism is in place."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Set Output
        id: set_output
        env:
          COMMIT_SHA: ${{ inputs.commit_sha }}
        run: |
          echo "snapshot_name=iterate-sandbox-${COMMIT_SHA}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
```
